en.title: Reflexive pronouns
en.summary: A reflexive pronoun shows that the subject and the object are the same.

paragraphs: A reflexive pronoun ends in -self (singular) or -selves (plural). It refers back to the subject of the sentence. English has myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves and themselves.

items: She looked at **herself** in the mirror.

paragraphs: The pronoun must agree with the subject in person and number. Singular you has yourself, but plural you has yourselves. Use the reflexive when subject and object are the same person; use an ordinary object pronoun when they are different.

blocks.html:
SubjectReflexiveExample
ImyselfI taught myself.
you (singular)yourselfHelp yourself.
he / she / ithimself / herself / itselfHe hurt himself.
weourselvesWe blamed ourselves.
you (plural)yourselvesEnjoy yourselves.
theythemselvesThey defended themselves.

sections.title: When English does not use a reflexive

paragraphs: Many English verbs that describe washing, dressing or feeling do not take a reflexive pronoun, unlike the same verbs in many other languages. We say wash, dress and shave when the meaning is clear. Use the reflexive for emphasis or contrast.

blocks.html:
Without reflexiveWith reflexive
He washed and dressed.He dressed himself (without help).
I feel tired.I told myself it was fine.
We met at six.We introduced ourselves.

paragraphs: A reflexive pronoun can also emphasise the subject: I did it myself means nobody helped me. By + reflexive means alone: She lives by herself.

items: Unnatural: **He shaved himself every morning.** Natural: **He shaved every morning.**
Wrong: **Myself and John went.** Right: **John and I went.**

ro.title: Pronumele reflexive
ro.summary: Pronumele reflexiv arată că acțiunea verbului se întoarce la persoana care face acțiunea.

paragraphs: Pronumele reflexiv arată o acțiune făcută asupra propriei persoane. Subiectul face acțiunea și tot el o primește. Folosim aceste pronume cu multe verbe obișnuite.
Pronumele reflexiv se schimbă după persoană și număr. Pronumele stă de obicei în fața verbului. La persoana a treia (singular și plural), forma este mereu „se”.

blocks.html:
PersoanăPronume reflexivExemplu
EumăEu mă trezesc devreme.
TuteTu te piepteni acum.
El / EaseEa se odihnește puțin.
NoineNoi ne bucurăm mult.
VoivăVoi vă grăbiți la școală.
Ei / EleseEi se plimbă în parc.
